newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK VUB SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE BOND ISSUE.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK VUB SHAREHOLDERS APPROVE BOND ISSUE.

text.p: Shareholders of Slovak bank VUB a.s. on Friday approved a plan to issue three billion crowns worth of 10-year bonds in 1997, and another 4.5 billion crowns worth of paper with a similar maturity in 1998.
"The volumes of these two tranches is the upper ceiling and we will specify the exact sum later this year," VUB Vice- president Dusan Paulik said at the bank's annual general meeting.

VUB a.s., Slovakia's largest commercial bank, posted 1996 gross profit, calculated according to international accounting standards (IAS), of 79.6 million crowns compared to 2.91 billion crowns in 1995.
Paulik said the bank was satisfied with this result as it also created reserves totalling 1.5 billion crowns for classified loans.
